cnn_vs_mlp.stress: fixed perturbations of the test images (augment.STRESS, seed 999); reporting only
cnn_vs_mlp.interpretability_note: Both models are inspected with the same tool (execution explorer). MLP first-layer neurons have one weight per pixel and can be drawn as 28x28 maps; CNN kernels are small (k x k) and shared across positions, so their weights are easy to draw but a single kernel says little about the final decision without the following stages. This is a qualitative statement, not a measured score.

protocol: Train 50 000 / validation 10 000 (stratified split of the official training set) / official test set. Hyper-parameters selected on validation only; test evaluated for the final configurations.

preprocessing.image: 28x28 grayscale, bright object on dark background

layers.note: score_k = sum over rounds of alpha_t * 1[tree_t predicts k]
